commitment_hint.description: Optional instruction for what this channel should display (e.g., publish PublicNotice short digest).

identifier.description: Stable identifier for this channel (e.g., domain:elections.example, @Handle, alerts@elections.example).

last_verified.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD last verification time for this channel entry.

owner_org.description: Optional owner/operator identity for this channel (helps interpret third-party mirrors).

url.description: Optional URL/URI for this channel (keep stable; prefer canonical landing pages).

verification_method.description: Optional verification method shorthand (dns_control+tls, account_security, spf_dkim_dmarc, independent_operator, etc).

directory_id.description: Stable identifier for this directory series (updates may chain via previous_directory_payload_sha256).

directory_version.description: Schema version of this directory payload.

keys_url.description: Optional pointer to key discovery (e.g., a public-evidence-portal keys.json; see docs/71).

mirror_index_url.description: Optional pointer to a mirror index surface (see docs/200).

public_notice_feed_url.description: Optional pointer to the current PublicNoticeFeed surface (see docs/200).

public_notice_signing_keyset_payload_sha.description: Optional digest of the latest PublicNoticeSigningKeyset payload bytes for this scope.

status_board_url.description: Optional pointer to the human-facing status board / rumor-control index (see docs/195).

well_known_url.description: Optional pointer to the domain-first /.well-known discovery surface (see docs/204).

generated_at.description: When this directory payload was generated (best effort).

previous_directory_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of the previous OfficialChannelDirectory *payload* bytes in this series (rollback/rewrites detection).

sequence.description: Optional monotonically increasing counter for operator convenience. Not authoritative without the hash chain.
